formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x2 : ℕ), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 x2 x1 → (∀ (x4 : ℕ), Monotone fun (x5 : Fin x2 → Bool) => PEqualNP.BlindGate.wireValue x1 x2 x5 x4) ∧ ∀ (x4 x5 x6 : ℕ), x1.gates[x4]? = Option.some { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, inputs := [x5, x6] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate } → ∀ (x8 : Fin x2 → Bool), PEqualNP.BlindGate.wireValue x1 x2 x8 (x2 + x4) = (PEqualNP.BlindGate.wireValue x1 x2 x8 x5 && PEqualNP.BlindGate.wireValue x1 x2 x8 x6))
plain_statement: It is false that: In every AND/OR circuit on n inputs with each gate reading exactly two earlier wires, every wire is a monotone function of the input, and every AND gate reading wires a and b is true exactly where both a and b are.
